question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

"I've just bought a car," said Amar, "But it isn't insured yet. So I cannot take you for a ride."

options.text: Amar said that he just bought a car but it wasn't insured till then. So, he could not take me for a ride.
Amar said that he had just bought a car but it wasn't insured till then. So, he could not be taken for a ride.
Amar said that he had just bought the car but it wasn't insured till then. So, he could not take me for a ride.
Amar said that he had just bought a car but it wasn't insured till then. So, he could not take me for a ride.

solution:
The correct answer is **'Amar said that he had just bought a car but it wasn't insured till then. So, he could not take me for a ride.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The context of the question involves a transformation from direct to indirect speech, where it's crucial to maintain the meaning while altering the grammatical form as per the rules of reported speech.
 
• The original statement (present perfect tense) "I've just bought a car," gets correctly transformed to past perfect tense- "he had just bought a car" in indirect speech.
 
• The Present Perfect "have bought" is appropriately changed to the Past Perfect "had bought" according to indirect speech rules. 
 
• The second part of the original sentence "It isn't insured yet," is correctly reported as "but it wasn't insured till then".
 
• The Present Simple "isn't insured" is suitably transformed into the Past Simple "wasn't insured" following the rules of indirect speech.
 
• The last part "So I cannot take you for a ride" is accurately portrayed as "So, he could not take me for a ride".
 
• The Present "cannot" changes to Past "could not" as per indirect speech rules, and the exact meaning is preserved as it talks about Amar's inability to give a ride due to the uninsured status of the car.

**Correct indirect form**- Amar said that he had just bought a car but it wasn't insured till then. So, he could not take me for a ride.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4.**
